$comment: The GitHub App permissions of each agent role, in the keys and values of GitHub's App manifest (`default_permissions`). The roles table in 03-agents.md is the rule; this file is its machine-readable twin, read by `kanon apps` to build each App's manifest, and tests/unit/agent-permissions.test.ts fails when the two disagree (K-PRIN-2). Each role holds its row of the roles table plus Metadata: read, which K-ADOPT-8 adds to every App. Change the table and this file in the same commit.
$apps: The three GitHub Apps of ADR 0013, as chapter 03's Apps table groups the roles. Each App holds the union of its roles' rows of the roles table plus Metadata: read, and any permission in `broadened`, which K-AGENT-3 records with its reason. A role named here may be any row of the roles table, so the Releaser, which is not an agent, belongs to its own App. Until the release that completes step L4 of plan 0005, `kanon apps` and apps-check read `roles` only.

broadened.$why: For the kanon/role: implementer commit status only: a fixed step of the Implementer's lanes mints a token narrowed to Commit statuses write after the agent has finished, and no agent's token holds it (ADR 0013, decision 3).
